譙王司馬恬 is one titled name (Sima Tian, Prince of Qiao). The original splits him into Sima Tian plus a separate Prince Qiao and invents a staff-officer relation; the replacement restores the correct apposition.
He also served as northern campaign aide under Prince Qiao's staff officer Sima Tian.
He also served as northern campaign aide under Sima Tian, Prince of Qiao.
Same unit: 譙王司馬恬 is not 'Prince Qiao's staff officer Sima Tian.' The proposed literal correctly names one man as Sima Tian, Prince of Qiao.

The Spring and Autumn principle is that a mother is honored through her son; once she bears the title of consort, ritual mourning follows the standard form. Thus Duke Cheng gave his mother the title of lady, and Duke Wen wore three years of mourning.

The Spring and Autumn principle is that a mother is honored through her son; once she bears the title of consort, ritual mourning follows the standard form. Thus Cheng Feng received the title of lady, and Duke Wen wore three years of mourning.
成風 is the lady Cheng Feng who 顯夫人之號; reading it as Duke Cheng invents a male duke and wrong agency. The repair correctly names Cheng Feng and keeps Duke Wen for 文公.

The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that the mother is ennobled through the son; once she is styled lady, ritual garments follow the orthodox rule. Thus Duke Cheng displayed the title of lady, and Duke Wen wore three years of mourning.
